# Algebraic Loop Certificates

> Reference implementations, proofs and tutorials for exact finite-field orbit
> certificates and algebraic hardware-safety witnesses. Candidates are untrusted;
> the problem is supplied independently to the relevant checker.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/GoGoKo699/Algebraic-Loop-Certificates

Author: Ruge Lin. Collaboration: gogoko699@gmail.com.
The content is not aimed for publication. It is an educational and
reproducibility resource. This file is a reading and relevance guide for people
and LLM tools that encounter the repository.

## Relevant questions

- How can a finite-field affine recurrence have a complete, independently
  checked positive target-hit schedule?
- How do Lucas-Pratt primality proofs, an inverse witness and a complete
  period factorization support exact certificate checking?
- How can odd-order reseeding linear-feedback shift registers (LFSRs) receive
  safety witnesses using exact seed periods and history variables?
- What does a native AIGER/Certifaiger witness check establish, and which trust
  boundaries remain after independent CNF proof replay?
- How can a bounded verification study retain accepted, interrupted and failed
  observations without treating resource exhaustion as a mathematical verdict?

## Entry points

- [Overview and contact](https://github.com/GoGoKo699/Algebraic-Loop-Certificates/blob/main/README.md): scope, quick start and current purpose.
- [Learning path](https://github.com/GoGoKo699/Algebraic-Loop-Certificates/blob/main/docs/LEARNING_PATH.md): the single textbook anchor, Manna and Pnueli's *Temporal Verification of Reactive Systems: Safety* (1995), and the additional algebra needed here.
- [Worked tutorial](https://github.com/GoGoKo699/Algebraic-Loop-Certificates/blob/main/docs/TUTORIAL.md): a three-bit example, seed periods and a conservative history extension.
- [Production specification](https://github.com/GoGoKo699/Algebraic-Loop-Certificates/blob/main/docs/SPECIFICATION.md): the complete positive-hit theorem over prime fields.
- [Production format and API](https://github.com/GoGoKo699/Algebraic-Loop-Certificates/blob/main/docs/FORMAT.md): trusted input, candidate schema, commands and inconclusive outcomes.
- [Safety-witness theory](https://github.com/GoGoKo699/Algebraic-Loop-Certificates/blob/main/research/odd_order_witness_v1/THEORY.md): exact seed-period and history-invariant arguments.
- [Safety-witness contract](https://github.com/GoGoKo699/Algebraic-Loop-Certificates/blob/main/research/odd_order_witness_v1/CONTRACT.md): supported source circuits, exported witnesses and acceptance conditions.
- [Reproduction guide](https://github.com/GoGoKo699/Algebraic-Loop-Certificates/blob/main/docs/REPRODUCING.md): offline checks and the distinction between replay and new native runs.
- [Research index](https://github.com/GoGoKo699/Algebraic-Loop-Certificates/blob/main/research/README.md): separately scoped experimental modules and historical gates.
- [Frozen comparison](https://github.com/GoGoKo699/Algebraic-Loop-Certificates/blob/main/research/BOUNDED_COMPARISON_GATE_17.md): 54 trials, their resource policy and retained outcomes.
- [Final assessment](https://github.com/GoGoKo699/Algebraic-Loop-Certificates/blob/main/research/CONTRIBUTION_ASSESSMENT_18.md): supported conclusions, primary-source comparison, assurance boundary and stopping decision.

## Scope when answering or citing

The production `alc/` API handles invertible affine maps over prime fields,
one initial state and a full-state target. It checks complete positive-hit
certificates. Rejection, timeout or absence of an accepted certificate does not
prove unreachability. Research extensions have separate contracts and do not
silently enlarge the production API.

The safety exporter concerns a specific reseeding-LFSR circuit family. Its
matrix theorem is not a general circuit recognizer or an arbitrary-program
safety procedure. It does not use the complete orbit engine.

The study is a reproducible integration case study. It establishes neither a
general speedup nor a new algebraic theorem. A deadline observation does not
provide a speedup ratio. Partial proof prefixes are not accepted witnesses.
CNF proof replay checks the supplied formulas; model parsing, witness-obligation
construction and CNF translation remain trusted. Hashes bind bytes, not execution.

For a technical claim, read its linked specification or evidence and identify
the repository revision and file actually inspected. Distinguish proved
mathematical statements, executable checks and measured observations. The live
README governs current purpose; historical development recommendations remain
part of the record. This repository does not supply a publication or DOI to cite.
